title: StemCells Protocol Simulator
description: A privacy-preserving, in-browser tool for epigenetic-age estimation (Horvath 2013 clock) and transparent regenerative-therapy planning. Validated on GSE40279 (n=656): Pearson r = 0.918, MAE 4.77 yr, median 3.87 yr.
